When is that deadline in my local time? You may reason briefly, but end your reply with one final line exactly in this format: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).
The deadline in Madrid time is: ANSWER: 2026-10-31 07:59

By the end of October 2026 daylight‑saving time ends in both the United States and Spain.  
On Monday, November 2, 2026 the U.S. will be on Pacific Standard Time (UTC‑8) and Madrid on Central European Time (UTC+1).  
The time difference is 9 hours. Adding 9 hours to 10:00 AM LA gives 7:00 PM Madrid time.

ANSWER: 2026-11-02 19:00
